{{Top|leg}}
A '''disruption field override generator''' was an electronic module installed in a [[Malkite poisoner's kit]]. It interferred with medical [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] readings, specifically blocking the scanner from detecting any traces of the [[Neurotoxin/Legends|neurotoxin]] [[h'gartha]]. Anyone reading the sensor readings would determine that an individual who died of h'gartha poisoning actually died of natural causes. The generator had to be within one [[Meter/Legends|meter]] of the scanner to work.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
